questions.q: Which Q3 form needs a formal, objective tone, a title and recommendations at the end?
questions.why: A report is formal and neutral, often with a title, subheadings and recommendations.

questions.q: How are the 25 marks for Paper 1 Question 3 split?
questions.why: Q3 rewards using and developing the text's ideas (15) and the quality of writing (10).

questions.q: What does it mean to "develop" ideas from Text C in Q3?
options: Invent new events for the character
Draw inferences grounded in the text, e.g. explain why or predict consequences
questions.why: Development goes beyond the surface but stays anchored in the text.

questions.q: Give two conventions of a speech.
questions.model: Any two: addresses the audience directly (e.g. "Good morning, everyone"); uses direct appeals with "you"/"we"; rhetorical questions; a memorable ending.
points: rhetorical questions / direct appeals / memorable ending
